system.description:
You feint out of your attack and pivot to instead slam your weapon to break down whatever wall was thrown against you.

If they summoned an interposing creatures, structure or construct, make a melee Taijutsu attack targeting the interposing structure, construct or creature, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 4d10 with a +4 bonus to its critical threat range.

If they gained THP, you have disadvantage on this attack roll. On a hit you deal your [Weapons damage + 4d12 with a +2 bonus to its critical threat range.

If you reduce the Construct or Structures Hit points to 0 or reduce the target creatures temporary hit points to 0, you can make one additional weapon attack as part of this jutsu’s casting.

Chain 2. Constructs and Structures treat this jutsu’s damage as if they were vulnerable to it.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, damage by 1d10 or 1d12 respectively.
